title: Wrapping up and George buying breakfast
summary: Closing, then a story of George buying Green breakfast on leaving.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Right. Well, uh, is there anything else? I mean, just about running out here. Right. Right. Right. Right. Right. Right.

Right. Right. Right. Right. Right. Right. Right. Right. Right. Right. Right. Right. Right. Right. And George, for no reason at all, bought me breakfast. We sat and had a long breakfast, maybe well over an hour. George Lewis had nothing he gained from me. He couldn't learn from me musically. There was no financial reward. He knew I cared. And I was leaving. It would be nice for him to buy me breakfast, which he did.
